incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered — service=inference-gateway env=prod-usw2 metric=5xx_rate(1m) > 8%
pagerduty-bot: Pager P1 fired: high error rate, escalation window 10m
alex: acked in PD, i'm oncall. pulling dashboards now
maya: i'm here, checking pods and k8s events
raj: seeing a sharp 502 spike from proxy layer, started ~15:41 UTC
carla: any customer impact yet?
cs-liz: we have 3 customer reports coming in: timeouts and failed requests on embeddings endpoint
alex: ok team — runbook: step1 confirm scope, step2 scale gateway, step3 fallback routing. will start scale now
maya: scaling inference-gateway to +2 replicas (kubectl scale deploy/inference-gw -n prod --replicas=6)
opsbot: Scaling action started: deployment/inference-gw -> 6 replicas
raj: checking envoy logs: repeated upstream reset/keepalive errors for auth-proxy cluster
sre-jen: joining, looking at keepalive and proxy health
carla: logs show kvcache evictions spiking at same time: "kvcache: evict prefix=... count=1200"
raj: that could cause more cold starts => upstream timeouts cascade to 502s
maya: warming new replicas by hitting /health and a few sample endpoints to populate caches
alex: also enabling soft-fallback policy: divert 20% traffic to cpu-quantized model variant while we stabilize
carla: applied fallback config to route: {fallback_model=redwood/llama-3b-quant, fallback_ratio=20%}
raj: temporary proxy tweak: bump keepalive to 120s and increase retry window to 2s, applying configmap update now
opsbot: ConfigMap updated: envoy-proxy-config -> rolling update started
alex: monitoring metrics — 5xx rate trending down from 9.6% -> 4.2% in last 2m
sre-jen: envoy logs confirm fewer upstream resets after keepalive bump
cs-liz: customers reporting fewer failures in the last 3 minutes
maya: cache miss rate also falling as warmed replicas finish buffering requests
carla: good. can we capture a brief summary for postmortem? owner for RCA?
alex: assign to raj to investigate proxy keepalive interactions with kvcache pressure (suspect cascading retries)
raj: will open ticket INFR-2345 and start collecting traces and heap snapshots from kvcache process
alex: PD: leaving escalation window open — will escalate to SRE lead if not stable by +10m
incident-bot: PD escalation scheduled in 7m if error rate > 5%
sre-jen: taking point on short-term mitigation, raj owns RCA follow-ups
alex: metric check: 1m 5xx at 2.1% and falling, customer impact minimal now
cs-liz: customers on slack confirm requests succeeding — will follow up with emails
carla: note for post-incident: look at kvcache eviction policy and model warmup sequencing during scale events
opsbot: Rolling update complete for deployment/inference-gw
alex: leaving handoff: i'll stay until green for 10m then close pager. thanks team
incident-bot: PD: incident noted as under investigation — auto-close check in 8 minutes
alex: great work everyone :thumbsup: :heart:
